english.title: Conspire to conceal / disguise / convert / transfer / remove criminal property
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) conspired together with

(A)_[**(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..)]_
(B)_[**(..SPECIFY THE PERSONS..)]_
(C)_[another person]_
(D)_[other persons]_

to conceal, disguise, convert, transfer or remove criminal property, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PROPERTY..), by means of **(..SPECIFY THE MANNER..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 1(1) of the Criminal Law Act 1977.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
conspired to conceal/disguise/convert/transfer/remove criminal property

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) See subsection 327(2) for circumstances in which a person does not commit the substantive offence.
(ii) Concealing, disguising, criminal property includes concealing its nature, source, location, disposition, movement or ownership or any right with respect to it (section 327(3)).
(iii) MoPI group cannot be established from the offence code alone. Group 2 or 3 may apply depending on the nature of the related crimes. Manual MoPI review is required.
